issues.description: The UML/problem statement and the template declare singFarmSongVerse as a private helper in Farm, but the solution implements it as protected. This visibility mismatch between the specification/template and the solution can confuse students about the intended access level and expected design of the helper method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the solution's singFarmSongVerse signature to private (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) to match the UML/template, or update the UML/problem statement and template to indicate protected if broader access is intended. Prefer making the solution method private to align with the original UML and template.
